title: Armillary: a label-free coordinate system for stellar spectra (code and data)
description: Armillary makes a coordinate system for a set of stellar spectra from the spectra alone, and transfers labels from a few labelled stars to all the other stars through the same neighbour graph. This record holds the Python package, a tutorial on synthetic spectra, and the data products of Ting & Saad (2026): the coordinates of 202,932 APOGEE DR17 stars and 104,799 DESI DR1 stars, the training sets, and the labels transferred from each training set. data/README.md describes every table.
